preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How the app suggests and paces activities. Saved on this device only.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the whole app, including games and lessons. Saved on this device.

route.title: Route
route.description: Optional. A route chooses suggested games and settings; it never limits what you can play.

goal.title: Daily practice goal
goal.description: A voluntary goal shown on the home screen. Not reaching it has no consequence.

relaxed.title: Relaxed timing by default
relaxed.description: Start every game without answer limits and with longer memorisation time. Relaxed sessions are saved but do not set records.

freePlay.title: Free play
freePlay.description: Open all ten levels of every game. Without it, level 1 is open and each next level opens after a session with performance 50+ or after three completed sessions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Adjust reading, motion and pace. Changes apply immediately.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Scales all text and controls. Browser zoom also works.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.description: Turns off transitions and decorative animation. By default the app follows your system setting.

noLimits.title: No time limits
noLimits.description: Relaxed timing for every game: no answer limits, double memorisation time and feedback that waits for you.

always.title: Also available everywhere
always.keyboard: Every game can be played with the keyboard; answer options have number keys.
always.howToPlay: “How to play” reopens the instructions at any moment during a game.
always.shapes: Shapes always differ in form as well as colour; feedback uses text and symbols, not only colour.
always.reaction: Reaction games need quick responses; their pages say so. See docs/accessibility.md for known limits.

data.title: Your data
data.description: This demo has no accounts and no server: everything lives in this browser’s local storage.

stored.title: What is stored
stored.results: Game results: level, score, accuracy, timing and date of each session.
stored.learning: Learning progress of the programming course.
stored.days: Days you practised, daily challenges and your weekly target.
stored.noPersonal: No name, email, location or other personal details are collected.

reset.title: Reset demo data
reset.description: Deletes all results, history, milestones, course progress and preferences on this device. This cannot be undone.
reset.confirm: Are you sure? Everything stored by this app on this device will be deleted.
reset.failed: Some data could not be deleted. Your browser may be blocking storage.
